events.verdict: Fox (SAS) legally contests Hunter's (ATL) jump shot, making high-five contact after the ball is released.
Hunter (ATL) engages and disengages with Wembanyama (SAS) on the perimeter and allows him to move freely.
Wembanyama (SAS) sets the pick on Daniels (ATL) and the leg contact is marginal.
Hunter (ATL) briefly places his hands on Wembanyama's (SAS) body and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Hunter (ATL) rests a hand on Wembanyama's (SAS) body as he starts his upward shooting motion before immediately removing it.
Wembanyama (SAS) and Hunter (ATL) come together at the same spot and the contact is marginal.
Young (ATL) briefly grasps Wembanyama's (SAS) leg as he rolls towards the basket and the contact is marginal.
Hunter (ATL) contests Paul's (SAS) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Daniels (ATL) dislodges Wembanyama (SAS) from his rebounding position.
Hunter (ATL) grasps and immediately releases Wembanyama's (SAS) jersey.
Daniels (ATL) rests a hand on Wembanyama's (SAS) body before immediately removing it as he begins his upward shooting motion.
Sochan (SAS) makes clean contact to the ball as he pursues the rebound.
Young (ATL) stops short in front of Sochan (SAS), who continues forward into him and initiates body contact that affects Young's shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position during Fox's (SAS) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) reaches for the rebound and brushes Wembanyama's (SAS) wrist during his dunk attempt.
Young (ATL) places his arm against Fox (SAS) and releases to receive the throw-in.
Paul (SAS) rests a forearm against Young's (ATL) body and immediately removes it as he begins his upward shooting motion.
Replay review of the foul called on Okongwu (ATL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Okongwu makes contact to Wembanyama's (SAS) wrist, affecting his shot attempt at the rim.
